info.title: InTest.Cli
info.description: Generates a committed, owned MSTest project that exercises a deployed API over real HTTP, from its OpenAPI document.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: InTest — generate API integration tests from an OpenAPI document.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate tests from the configured OpenAPI document.

options.name: --check
options.description: Compare committed output against a fresh render instead of writing. Reads only; writes nothing under Generated/ or coverage-report.json. [default: False]

options.name: --spec
options.description: Path of the OpenAPI document relative to the test project directory, or the URL it is served from.

commands.name: repair
commands.description: Create missing fixtures and add sentinels for new required properties.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Adopt the running intest version: regenerate against it, then bump intestVersion and the .config/dotnet-tools.json pin.
